## Notable Professional Experience
- **Wazuh (Jan 2026 – Present):** Full-Stack Engineer. Designed and built the Wazuh AI Assistant end to end, from issue and design to merged PR, for a platform used by 90,000+ users. Designed and shipped security hardening (provider API-key encryption at rest, an encryption key generated on install, and log/CSV injection fixes), and built Case management, Engine Health dashboards, and a unified Security Analytics search, alongside bundle minification and dependency reduction. 130+ merged PRs across wazuh-dashboard, wazuh-dashboard-plugins, and wazuh-dashboard-security-analytics.
- **Tres Pi Medios for Stanley Black & Decker (Jul 2024 – Jan 2026):** Designed and built an internal tool loan and repair app for Italy that cut task completion time by 50%, an Azure Function integrating generative AI to automate Zendesk support replies for the US and Canada, and real-time data feeds for Power BI dashboards with i18n support for Italian and English.
- **SuperGIROS (Aug 2023 – Jul 2024):** Designed and built internal back-office tools serving 1,100+ financial service points in Norte de Santander, a Node.js sales chatbot that reduced helpdesk support calls by 60%, and web improvements that raised load speed by 40%.
